relations.evidence: You can also call the function [VECTOR\_DISTANCE()](../n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/vectorfun.md#vector%5Fdistance) to find similar vectors. However, this function does not use the Hyperscale Vector index to perform the vector search. Instead, it performs a brute-force search for similar vectors. It's useful to measure the recall of your Hyperscale Vector index.
